heroHeadline:
UAP Disclosure:
Subpoena Threat, FBI Probe, and 'Things You Wouldn't Believe' as 16-Day EO Countdown Intensifies
heroSubtitle: Tracking official government actions, congressional hearings, declassified documents, and institutional statements on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena. Rep. Luna is coordinating with Chairman Comer on a formal subpoena for 46 classified Pentagon UAP videos the Defense Department failed to deliver by her April 14 deadline. Trump told reporters on May 3 that he personally interviewed pilots who said they 'saw things you wouldn't believe.' The FBI is investigating the April 2024 death of Matthew Sullivan, an Air Force/NSA veteran who agreed to testify before Congress on classified UAP programs, at Rep. Burlison's request. A Greer National Press Club disclosure event featuring Army Green Beret testimony is set for May 8. Sixteen days remain until Trump's May 20 executive order 90-day deadline.
footerNote: This tracker documents official statements, legislative actions, and institutional processes related to UAP disclosure. It does not validate or endorse the claims contained within official testimonies. EDITORIAL NOTE: Events record that officials made specific claims — not that those claims are verified as factually true. All contested claims include opposing positions.
